KnowledgeDigest 10.0.0 — Major Upgrade: Unified conversion of textbooks/PDFs into multimodal, personalized learning assets.

- Converts educational materials or topics into personalized notes, quizzes, slides, mind maps, and audio courses, tailored to user’s grade and interests.
- Automatically analyzes and structures content, extracting chapters, key concepts, learning objectives, and knowledge dependencies.
- Supports multiple output formats: handwritten-style notes, interactive quizzes, slides (PDF/PPTX), mind maps (image/Mermaid), and teacher-student audio courses (MP3).
- New workflow for handling cases with or without uploaded materials, including content search and user confirmation steps if no files are provided.
- Grade level and interest adaptation for all materials, ensuring suitable language, detail, and style for each user.
- Standardized, private delivery: file paths only, no inline previews or autoplay of media.

KnowledgeDigest 1.0.0 — Unified Learning Content Converter

- Converts textbooks or PDFs into personalized, multimodal learning materials (handwritten notes, quizzes, slides, audio courses, mind maps).
- Automatically adapts content for different grade levels and user interests.
- Supports multiple output formats: annotated notes (PDF), quiz webpages (HTML), slides (PDF/PPTX), mind maps (image/Mermaid), audio courses (MP3).
- Can generate courseware from user uploads or via search if no material is provided.
- Extracts structured knowledge, including chapter hierarchy, key concepts, objectives, and builds a knowledge graph for the material.
- Assets are delivered as file paths only—no inline previews or auto-play for audio/video.
